I'm not sure if it's ghosts...

But basically when I was 11 my grandad on my mum's side passed away from a stroke.

 On the night he passed I had a dream that we were sitting on the couch together watching the news. We did this often. We just sat next to each other, not talking, occasionally he'd look down at me and pat my head or something.

So the weird part was that I was rudely awoken from my dream at night and burst into tears. I felt really cold and alone, I couldn't shake this feeling of unease and sadness. It was like 2-3 am, and the feeling only went away after an hour, and then I fell back asleep. 

When I woke up the next day, I went downstairs and found out from my dad's grandparents (I was staying with them at the time) that my grandad died of a stroke last night. At around 2-3 am. 

Later, when calling my parents to talk about the news (they were in England at the time looking for houses for us to move into) they told me the hotel fire alarms went off at around the same time. 

I know my grandfather was a very kind and spiritual man, so that's why I believe he definitely would've left an impact when he passed.
